title: Stop Saying "Very Expensive"! 4 Better Ways to Say It #shorts
description:
Don't say "very expensive". Say one of these instead:
• Overpriced: It's overpriced!
• Costly: The repairs were costly.
• Exorbitant: The rent is exorbitant.
• The idiom: It costs an arm and a leg!

Full lesson: Stop Saying "Very" in English: 30 Words to Use Instead of "Very" (With Pictures)
